authorship.author: Yuval Ganor
authorship.note: third-party coverage about Nimrod Dvir; not a sample of his writing. Ganor is responding to Nim's Ynet column of June 10, 2009 (inventory W071).

completenessChecks: All 12 body text blocks (11 paragraphs plus the author biography line) translated in source order; one section heading retained.
All three body hyperlinks preserved on the same words (Nim's column, the Survivor victory news item, Hoshen).
All four image captions translated with photographer credits; the sidebar image stays linearized after the body as in the Hebrew.
First and last substantive paragraphs compared against source-record.json firstTextBlock and lastTextBlock.
voiceChecks: Ganor's argumentative, first-person reply register is kept: direct admissions ('I admit that on first reading I nodded'), rhetorical questions, and the closing conditional sentence.

Phrases Ganor quotes from Nim's column (suburban queen, cowgirl in withdrawal, with pleasant ease) are translated literally so they can be matched against the W071 translation; the W071 translator should align wording if it differs.
No softening of the charge that the column's position is homophobic; 'disguised as principles' and the talkback quote are rendered as bluntly as the Hebrew.
decisions: 'קוקיצת הפרברים' rendered 'suburban queen'; 'בוקרת בקריז' rendered 'cowgirl in withdrawal' (drug-craving sense of קריז).
'הומואים סטרייטים' rendered 'straight gays' with the Hebrew quotation marks kept.
'וכך קיבלנו את ההבחנה בין...' and the following one-line paragraph 'בין אמיר פיי גוטמן...' are kept as two separate paragraphs, matching the source's fragment.
Show titles: Survivor, Big Brother, The Block, Seven Days (Shiv'a Yamim) rendered in English; people's names transliterated (Schneidrowski, Fay Guttman, Uchovsky, Buganim, Bublil).
Hoshen's self-description is translated as the source words it (gay, lesbian, bisexual and transgender community).
sourceProblems: The Hebrew says the talkback quote contains homophobia 'in five words'; the English quote also has five words, so the count is preserved.
No source typos requiring a note.
unresolvedQuestions: Whether to display this piece on the website at all, given it is a rebuttal to Nim rather than his work; it is translated for completeness of the archive.
